name: example-ci-gate
description: PATTERN: agent pane + a ONE-SHOT check run once on open (not an always-running sentinel — see example-sentinel.json for that). Do this for a repo with a single documented CI/lint/test entrypoint: 'is the tree green right now' becomes the first thing you see, not something you remember to run. Copy this into your personal tier (see README's Private vs. public), point working_dir at your own repo, and swap the command for your own entrypoint.

panes.label: CI
panes.cmd: bash your-ci-entrypoint.sh; echo; echo '--- finished (exit code above) ---'; exec $SHELL
